Subject: MAP kickoff: Executive alignment, escalation path, and Q4 evaluation outcomes

Hi Elena & Samir —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. As discussed, we want to kick off a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to get Novatech through evaluation to a Q4 pilot decision. I’ve looped in a few Redwood stakeholders so we can align on exec sponsorship, escalation paths, and the specific outcomes we’ll measure by quarter-end.

High-level MAP items (proposed):
- Week 1 (this week): Executive sponsor intro + confirm scope & success criteria
- Weeks 2–3: Technical evaluation (deployment in your staging, basic perf benchmarks)
- Week 4: SOC2/data handling review & security questionnaire turnaround
- Weeks 5–8: Pilot with sample traffic, cost/latency tuning recommendations
- Week 10: Final decision checkpoint + procurement/contract readiness

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm your executive sponsor for the program (VP/CTO level).
2) Confirm any additional internal stakeholders you want on the MAP (product owners, SRE lead).
3) Can we book a 60-minute kickoff working session next Tuesday or Wednesday to finalize the MAP and timeline?

I’ve attached a draft MAP spreadsheet (MAP-Novatech-v1.xlsx) and the SOC2 evidence request that typically comes up.

If helpful, I’m proposing Redwood’s VP Product, Rishi Malhotra, as our executive sponsor for strategic alignment and escalation. Rishi — I’ll add a short note below so you have context.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

1) Executive sponsor: Samir (CTO) will be the exec sponsor for Novatech. I’ll confirm formally after syncing with him this afternoon.
2) Internal attendees to include: Priya Menon (Head of Data Platform, priya.menon@novatech.com) and our Security lead (Jules Park, jules.park@novatech.com) for the SOC2 items.
3) Kickoff: Wednesday 21 Oct works best for us (we have a board offsite the earlier week).

On escalation — we need a single-point escalation path on the Redwood side who can make tradeoff decisions (latency vs cost vs compliance) and an executive contact for contracts. Could you confirm those roles?

Thanks for the intro, Diego. Hi Elena & Samir — I’m Rishi, VP Product at Redwood. Happy to serve as your executive sponsor for the MAP. A few quick alignment notes from my side:

- Outcome focus for Q4: production-ready pilot with clear latency & cost targets, and a security signoff for handling PII in staging.
- Escalation expectations: our priority is to keep the pilot on schedule. If we hit a blocker that requires cross-org tradeoffs, escalate to me and I’ll coordinate commercial/engineering decisions.
- Weekly check-ins: recommend 30-minute standups during the technical evaluation phase (weeks 2–4) and a weekly business sync thereafter.

I’ll be on the kickoff call and can make time for ad-hoc escalations as needed.

Best,
